newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Direct Petrogal/Saudi talks to resume in week.
newsitem.headline: Direct Petrogal/Saudi talks to resume in week.

text.p: Direct talks between Saudi Aramco and Petrogal on proposals for the world's largest state-owned oil company to take a stake in the Portuguese concern should resume within a week, according to an official statement.
Petrocontrol, a private consortium holding 45 percent of the Portuguese firm, said that the last round of negotiations between the three sides had been held on June 11 and 12.

The new talks will involve representatives of the Saudi concern, two representatives of Petrocontrol and two representatives of the Portuguese government, the statement said. The place and exact timing of the fresh round of talks has still to be set, it added.
